  scope?: string;
  colspan?: number;
  rowspan?: number;
  abbr?: string;
  class?: string;

defineSlots<{ default?(): unknown }>();
const {
  scope,
  colspan: colSpan,
  rowspan: rowSpan,
  abbr,
  class: className,
} = defineProps<TableHeadCellProps>();
const attrs = useAttrs();
const cls = computed(() => cn(tableHeadCellVariants(), className));
</script>

<template>
  <th
    :class="cls || undefined"

    :rowspan="isSetNum(rowSpan) ? String(rowSpan ?? 0) : undefined"
